title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
original_title: Norm: The Tale of Norm Macdonald
plot_overview: This documentary follows the life and career of a master of deadpan humor, tracing a path marked by uncompromising choices and contradictions. It offers a look at the person and performer behind a distinctive comedic style.
will_you_like_this: You’ll like this if you enjoy documentaries about distinctive comedians and careers full of contradictions; Not for you if you’re looking for a scripted story or detailed critical reviews.
review_summary: Pros: deadpan humor; complex subject; career-spanning focus | Cons: no review details; tone may vary
